The best Bún Chả in Hanoi: Michelin star and quality absolutely deserved!
Aug 2026 • Couples
If you want to taste an authentic Bún Chả in Hanoi, this place at number 21 Nguyễn Hữu Huân is an absolutely mandatory stop. Everything was simply "top" from the first to the last minute!
The recognition in the Michelin Guide is totally deserved: the grilled meat is tender, flavorful, and has that fantastic, perfect smokiness, immersed in a delicious warm broth that is perfectly balanced between sweet and savory. The portions are generous, accompanied by very fresh rice noodles, an abundance of aromatic herbs, and crispy, delicious nem (fried spring rolls), including seafood and vegetarian ones.
The environment is welcoming, clean, and well-organized over several floors, while the staff proved to be very fast, kind, and always ready to explain how to best enjoy the dish.
Excellent value for money for a gastronomic experience of this level in the heart of the Old Quarter. Highly recommended with all my heart!

Bun Cha Ta
Thank you so much for your lovely review and for choosing Bun Cha Ta in Hanoi ❤️

We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed the balanced sweet and salty flavor of our broth — that harmony is exactly what makes traditional Hanoi bun cha so special. Our team works hard every day to keep the authentic taste just right, so your kind words mean a lot to us.

It’s also wonderful to know that our staff made you feel welcome and well taken care of. We always aim to provide not only delicious food but also friendly and efficient service.

We hope you enjoy exploring other bun cha places in Hanoi — and of course, we would be delighted to welcome you back anytime to compare again 😊

Warm regards,
Bun Cha Ta – Hanoi
